verdict.rationale: Runloop's Axons/Broker system provides an event stream for agent lifecycle (suspend on idle, wake on demand, recover state, hand off) and devbox start/stop offers idle-based automatic shutdown, which are event-driven primitives an AI-native user could build on. However, there is no documented rule-definition mechanism (e.g., a conditional 'on event X do action Y' API/UI) — the evidence shows infrastructure for event streaming and lifecycle state, not a general-purpose automation rules engine.  Missing for 10: explicit user-defined trigger/rule syntax or API, examples of arbitrary custom actions bound to events, and any UI for rule management.
